mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel) AS novel_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter_subscription WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS subscription_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) FROM chapter_subscription WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS subscription_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reward_tip WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS tip_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM reward_tip WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS tip_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel WHERE audit_status = 0) AS pending_novel_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter WHERE audit_status = 0) AS pending_chapter_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE audit_status = 0) AS pending_comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel_rating WHERE review_audit_status = 0 AND review_content IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(review_content)) > 0) AS pending_rating_count

SELECT id, type, title, author, submitted_at FROM ( SELECT n.novel_id AS id, 'NOVEL' AS type, n.title AS title, u.nickname AS author, n.updated_at AS submitted_at FROM novel n JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id WHERE n.audit_status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT c.chapter_id AS id, 'CHAPTER' AS type, CONCAT(n.title, ' / ', c.title) AS title, u.nickname AS author, c.updated_at AS submitted_at FROM chapter c JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = c.novel_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id WHERE c.audit_status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT c.comment_id AS id, 'COMMENT' AS type, LEFT(c.content, 80) AS title, u.nickname AS author, c.created_at AS submitted_at FROM comment c JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.audit_status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT r.rating_id AS id, 'RATING' AS type, LEFT(r.review_content, 80) AS title, u.nickname AS author, r.updated_at AS submitted_at FROM novel_rating r JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.review_audit_status = 0 AND r.review_content IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(r.review_content)) > 0 ) pending ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 8
